To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
it is indeed feasible to construct braneworld models that have a time-dependent extra spatial dimension.

it is possible to construct braneworld models with time-dependent extra dimensions and the nature of geodesics and particle production in such models depends on the type of warping and the temporal evolution of spacetime.

the geodesic motion of test particles in a dynamic braneworld is different in the cases of a time dependent scale factor, scale factor and warp factor, and that the quantum particle production in a dynamic branewrold is different in the different cases of a time dependant scale factor, scale, warp factor and extra dimension.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the classical and quantum features associated with the dynamic nature of the extra dimension.

the following aspects: (i) the construction of generalised braneworld cosmologies with different bulk sources and the effect on the brane dynamics (ii) the study of geodesic motion in the braneworld scenarios with a dynamic extra dimensions (iii) the issue of geodetic confinement (iv) particle production in the braneworld models.
a systematic study of certain classical and quantum aspects in generalised braneworld scenarios.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the dynamic nature of the bulk geometry, in general, leads to a richer phenomenology of the braneworld scenario.
, the generalised braneworld scenario with a time-dependent bulk geometry can be a very promising alternative to the usual brane-world scenario.
, the generalised braneworld scenarios, in general, exhibit a rich variety of features, which are not present in the original RS model.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have been able to demonstrate that the dynamic nature of extra dimension in the bulk does not necessarily lead to the instability of the brane.

the dynamic nature of extra dimension in braneworld models can be used to control particle production and thus the back reaction due thereto, and this is a very desirable feature of such models, as it can lead to a more realistic description of braneworld cosmologies.
, we have shown, how the dynamics of the extra dimension can have a significant impact on the dynamics of the brane and vice versa.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the braneworld scenarios with a dynamic extra-dimension can provide a rich arena for the study of various classical and quantum aspects.
the dynamic nature of the extra dimension can be exploited in a constructive manner.
it is possible to have a consistent braneworld model with a dynamic extra dimensions and a nontrivial warp factor, which is also free from the geodesic confinement problem.
